title: Grateful Dead Live at Manhattan Center on 1971-04-04
source: MSR > C >DAT3 > Delta DiO 2496 > SoundForge 7.0 > cdwav > flac > wav > flac

ai_review.summary: A must‑have soundboard capture of the magical April ’71 Manhattan Center show, with crystal‑clear audio and a stellar band performance.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave that this recording delivers the best‑ever April ’71 sound, citing amazing tones from Garcia, Phil, Bob (Weir) and Bill. The soundboard source is praised as crisp and balanced, making it an essential addition to any 1971 Dead collection.

ai_rating.rationale: Only a single enthusiastic review, but it highlights both exceptional musical performance and excellent soundboard quality; the limited data set reduces confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear, well‑balanced mix with no reported issues; reviewers recommend EQ tweaks for optimal playback but note the audio is already superb.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific setlist comments; overall the show is described as magical and representative of the high‑energy April ’71 era.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's sound was described as amazing.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil's playing was highlighted as amazing.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby (Bob Weir) was praised for his performance.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy's drumming was noted as amazing.
